points: Stage-2 hot path is two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 (geometry_core/src/chamfer.cpp), called from estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2. Default free coarse grid is ±0.15 m at 0.01 m and ±10° at 1° (31×31×21 = 20181 cells); fine grid is ±0.012 m at 0.001 m and ±1.2° at 0.2° (25×25×13 = 8125 cells). Each cell runs chamfer_cost_from_rotated on the cached prototype: 182 contour points at contour_spacing_m 0.03 (outer 94 plus two pockets of 44). Per stage this is O(Nθ·Nx·Ny·Nproto) bilinear samples.

The prior search usually runs as a second full grid. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 skips two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior only when lambda_eff <= lambda_floor 0.05, which needs free chamfer cost at or below about 0.00623 m. Otherwise prior coarse is ±0.10 m at the same 0.01 m / 1° steps (21×21×21 = 9261 cells) plus the same 8125-cell fine window. A typical frame therefore pays about 45700 cost evaluations, not one search.

Every search cell copies the prototype again. chamfer_cost_from_rotated assigns tls.translated = rotated (N×2 Eigen copy), bilinear-samples, then trimmed_mean_from_distances copies those N distances into a std::vector and std::sorts them, O(N log N) per cell. ChamferTls caches the rotation per theta index under OpenMP schedule(static); translation is not fused into the sampler. The OpenMP critical section only reduces per-thread argmins.

The distance image is a once-per-frame OpenCV dependency sized by padding, not by the pallet. rasterize_points_to_mask uses resolution_m 0.005 and padding_m 0.80, so a 1.20×0.14 m inlier span is about 561×349 pixels. close_mask clones that mask and connectedComponentsWithStats allocates a full label image. compute_distance_transform_v2 then allocates src, dist_px, and dist_m and calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE before either grid starts.

sample_face_points (geometry_core/src/backproject.cpp) scans every depth pixel and only then tests the RGB bbox. Each pixel pays K_depth_inv, apply_se3(R_dr, t_dr), and project_pinhole before the mask read, so the cost is O(Hd·Wd) even though the pallet is a small window. Accepted points are stored in per-thread std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> buckets and copied again row-by-row into a new MatrixXd. build_bbox_mask also zero-fills a full RGB-resolution mask and erodes it.

Plane fitting allocates several full copies of the face cloud before chamfer starts. ransac_plane_fit loops up to ransac_iters 100 (early stop at inlier ratio 0.85) and each iteration allocates an N-length residual ArrayXd plus a bool mask, then copies inliers into a MatrixXd for JacobiSVD. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 calls plane_inlier_mask (another residual pass) and copies inliers again into plane_points_3d. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates an N×3 relative matrix and an N×2 result; estimate_pca_long_axis allocates a centred N×2 matrix.

depth_image_to_meters always materializes a new CV_32FC1 frame via convertTo. A 16UC1 image is scaled by depth_scale; a 32FC1 image is copied at scale 1. Stage 2 never reads the ROS depth buffer in place.

The other inference dependency is pps_rtdetr_detector, upstream of pallet_pose_cpp_node. image_to_rgb copies the ROS buffer through bytes(msg.data) into numpy, and bgr8 swaps channels into a second array. preprocess resizes to input_size 640, then astype(float32), transpose to CHW, and ascontiguousarray. TensorRTBackend.infer copies the 1×3×640×640 input host-to-device and copies labels, boxes, and scores device-to-host plus a host .copy(). The mock_pipeline launch uses backend mock, which skips the engine. Postprocess is a score filter over the engine top-k with no NMS. select_detection is O(detections) and only the chosen bbox enters estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2. cached_prototype rebuilds the 182-point contour only when shape parameters change, so prototype construction is not per frame.
